name: 59847 · Lolo, MT
findings: ZIP 59847 (Lolo) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59847 (Lolo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 59847 (Lolo) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
